criteria.note: ensure_schema() creates note_contradictions(id,note_id,fact_id,dead_value,current_value,detected_at,cleared_at) with no column added to archival_notes (wq#576 precedent, per ticket text). dead_value_index() (note_contradiction_scan.py:82-99) builds the structured-token dead-value index from closed state_facts (<=60 chars, ^[A-Za-z0-9._:/@-]+$, §3.5). live_notes() (:102-112) scans archival_notes excluded the same way search_v3 already excludes them (not absorbed, revoked_at/superseded_by NULL). find_hits() (:115-142) applies the changelog + as-of suppressors and a negation-line skip (fixed to mask the matched token first, so a dead value that is itself a negation word like RETIRED still flags). scan() (:145-181) writes rows idempotently and clears rows for rescanned notes whose text no longer contains the dead value. Regression + idempotency + clearing + dry-run tests: ops/wq1610-minerva-archival-contradictions/test_note_contradiction_scan.py.
